title: Object-container and ship-navigation lines are not location, destination, or ship-ownership proof
action: streaming systems mention object containers, route objects, and ship entities

sensitivityHandling.notes: Object-container paths are synthetic and do not reveal a real place or player route.

expectedNonEvents.reason: Loaded object-container context is not proof the local player visited or stood there.
Quantum route object traces do not prove local-player travel intent or state.
Ship class/entity observation is not ownership, spawn, boarding, or piloting evidence.

correlation.notes: These lines may be retained as diagnostic unknown evidence but should not become user-facing facts.

knownLimitations: Future destination, quantum, and ship issues require controlled positive and negative captures.
verificationNotes: Unhappy-path parser tests should assert no location, destination, or ship lifecycle event is emitted.
